title: Harness Registry (post-orchestrator, v3)
description: Shape of manifests/harness.registry.json after the 2026-08-25 orchestrator removal. The v2 orchestrator-era schema (primary_orchestrators / downstream_gates / name_freeze / decision_semantics) lives at tag pre-orchestrator-removal.

primary_orchestrators.description: Must stay empty. A non-empty list means an orchestrator was reintroduced without redesigning the registry — bump schema_version instead.
